profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer & Tech Lead at NVIDIA Robotics | ex-TRI, ex-Google, ex-Intel
profile.jobTitle: Senior Staff Lead Software Engineer, Robotics Platform, Holoscan, Isaac OS
profile.summary:
Senior Staff Software Engineer & Technical Lead building the foundational software layer for the next generation of Physical AI and Embodied AI.

Currently driving the architectural direction and developer ecosystem for NVIDIA’s next-generation Robotics Platform, Isaac OS. I lead the end-to-end design, core runtime architecture, and APIs for our public open-source platform, translating complex, multimodal machine learning research into highly optimized, production-grade systems for global developers.

Core Expertise & Impact:
• Open-Source Platform Leadership: Spearheaded the architecture and successful public launch of Isaac OS (production docs & GitHub), establishing the open-source framework that powers real-time robot perception, orchestration, and developer APIs globally.

• Physical & Embodied AI Infrastructure: Designing scalable runtimes, real-time control systems, and low-latency sensor fusion pipelines required to run advanced LLM/VLM foundation models on edge robotics hardware.

• Research to Production: Pioneering the transition of multimodal machine learning algorithms from pure R&D into resilient, deterministic software architectures for autonomous systems.

• Technical Influence: Defining engineering standards, aligning cross-functional platform roadmaps with executive business strategy, and mentoring senior-to-principal technical talent across the organization.

positions.title: Senior Staff Lead Software Engineer, Robotics Platform, Holoscan, Isaac OS
positions.description:
At NVIDIA, I lead the software engineering and technical direction for NVIDIA’s Robotics Platform, Isaac OS, driving high-performance runtime features and core developer APIs that scale open-source world foundation models, Embodied AI, and Physical AI globally.

My role as Tech Lead involves guiding cross-functional teams to ensure cohesive integration of hardware, simulation, and multimodal AI frameworks. I also lead initiatives to innovate the ecosystem through advanced tooling and reference applications, fostering a robust environment for AI-driven robotic workflows.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Global AI Accelerator - Human Machine Interactive Research
positions.description:
- Lead Software Engineer aligning engineering, research, and product teams to scale enterprise-wide AI/ML and LLM capabilities on AWS Cloud Infrastructure
- Specialized in Applied AI, bringing XR/AR, ML/LLM models into advanced research and optimizing real-time inference performance and latency
- Pioneered LLM-first spatial computing on Apple Vision Pro, enabling real-time multimodal human-AI interaction for XR/AR
- Architected MLOps platforms (Kubernetes, Docker, SageMaker) for scalable model lifecycle, deployment, and distributed inference
- Owned end-to-end HMI systems (edge to cloud) integrating sensor fusion, AI/ML, LLMs, XR/AR, delivering 2X performance gains
- Established hybrid edge-cloud infrastructure, distributed architecture standards, accelerating AI/ML advanced research across global teams

positions.title: Software Technical Lead
positions.description:
• Directed multiple software teams responsible for building a real-time control system for Direct Carbon Air Capture with analytics pipelines securing Series B investor funding 

• Owned product vision, roadmap, and technical architecture for real-time industrial monitoring and control platform with a modern web-UI

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Software specialist in embedded systems, sensor fusion and AI-driven, robotic platforms for central teams in research and development

positions.title: Sensor Software Engineer, Autonomous Driving Group
positions.description: As a Sensor Software Engineer at Intel Corporation's Silicon Valley Innovation Center, I focused on delivering scalable solutions for the Mobileye Autonomous Driving Division. My role involved designing and optimizing embedded firmware for safety-critical hardware, collaborating with various teams to ensure real-time performance, and developing advanced sensor frameworks for sensor fusion that significantly enhance autonomous driving capabilities.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer, New Devices Group
positions.description: As an Embedded Software Engineer in the New Devices Group at Intel Corporation, I focused on delivering cutting-edge embedded software solutions for wearable and IoT devices. My role involved designing and testing prototypes to enhance bio-signal data processing efficiency, collaborating closely with hardware engineers for seamless integration, and implementing OTA updates to improve user experience. I also conducted extensive research for biomedical devices and novel algorithms to support project goals, ensuring the adoption of innovative solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern, Data Center
positions.description:
Developed software to automate data center infrastructure control systems and monitor power/cooling telemetry.

Implemented and tested server-side and cloud encryption protocols to secure enterprise-scale hardware infrastructure.

honors.title: Intel Scholar
honors.description: Awarded to those who are brilliant, accomplished and committed to the pursuit of advanced computer innovation. Intel's scholars benefit from ongoing development during their Intel internships that prepare them for careers post-graduation. Working on exciting ground-breaking projects, sessions with executives, workshops on resume writing, and interview coaching are all part of Intel's Scholars Program. It’s a great opportunity to set your career on a solid path while still in school.

honors.title: Advancing Women in Technology (AWT)
honors.description: The Advancing Women in Technology (AWT) Charitable Foundation awards annual scholarships to help strong  and educated women who are dedicated to furthering their education in the STEM related fields. The purpose of the scholarships is to advance diversity within the technology industry by enhancing the opportunities for women to enter the field through education, personal and professional growth, and the development of mentoring relationships in the technology community. Our scholarship awards are made possible through the generous support of our members, community and industry friends.
honors.issuer: Issued by Advancing Women in Technology Charitable Foundation · Oct 2016

volunteerExperiences.description: Judged VEX Robotics competition and gave feedback for aspiring students in STEM fields.

Mentored underprivileged children and talked to them about the importance of education (STEM) and staying physically active. Lead and participated in group activities which also got the girls working together as a team, thus teaching them importance of teamwork and dealing with other people.

projects.title: NVIDIA Isaac OS
projects.description: NVIDIA's native robotics stack and Physical AI platform designed for deploying humanoids, mobile robots, and manipulators. Enables robotics developers to build and deploy enterprise-grade physical AI robot applications with speed-of-light performance on NVIDIA Edge hardware.

projects.title: San Jose State University, Computer Engineering | Piano Gloves
projects.description:
The objective of this project is to create a glove which can produce a specific piano-key note based which finger is flexed. To accomplish this task, we had to do the following:

* Purchase all necessary parts 
* Simulate piano-key notes in MATLAB using the Karplus Strong Algorithm
* Port MATLAB Code to C using RTOS
* Sew Flex Sensors onto Gloves
* Create our own ADC circuit using OP-AMPS to handle 10 Analog inputs (1 per each finger)
* Configure the onboard DAC of the SJOne Board, as well as initializing GPIO ports
* Perform a full system integration for a finalized product

Optional Tasks
*Create a Real Time visualization based on which finger is flexed (which was implemented at the end of the report)

patents.title: Respiratory biological sensing
patents.description: An algorithm to detect respiration rate from a microphone on the nose bridge of glasses
